subject: Preflight: kit variants, signage tolerances & backwall clearance
messages:
From: Carla Diaz <carla@eventworks.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Preflight details for Redwood demo pod - needs on clearance and kit variants

Hi Evelyn,

Attaching the preflight pack for Moscone H3 — a couple of items I wanted flagged before we print final panels and consolidate kits: 

- Backwall clearance: the neighboring island has a hanging truss 12ft from our back edge; our mockup shows 11.8ft clearance at the center. Building will require 12in tolerance on fabric stretch.
- Signage tolerances: the 48" backwall vinyl will need a +0.5" margin for trim. Please confirm whether you want bleed for full-wrap prints or the more conservative centered panel.
- Kit variants: we listed two demo kit configs (A: 2 laptops, 1 battery bank; B: 1 laptop, 2 battery banks + tablet). Ops has asked which we consider primary for crate manifest.
- Freight pickup: LogiShip needs a 72-hour window to schedule early pickup; their ops contact is cc'd.

I included Preflight_Specs_v3.pdf and a quick clearance photo. If you can confirm the preferred kit variant and signage bleed by EOD Monday, we can lock files to print and confirm crate weights.

Thanks,
Carla
Senior Show Producer | EventWorks
attachments: Preflight_Specs_v3.pdf, backwall-clearance-photo.jpg

---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carla Diaz <carla@eventworks.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Preflight details for Redwood demo pod - needs on clearance and kit variants

Hi Carla — thanks for the pack and the photo, very helpful. Quick answers below so we can move to print: 

1) Backwall clearance: we cannot accept any risk of fabric catch on the truss. Please design for 12.5ft at the center (add 6" safety). If that changes cost materially let us know.
2) Signage: go with full-wrap +0.5" bleed on all three panels. We'll accept the slight extra trim cost to keep visuals consistent across touchpoints.
3) Kit variant: primary = Variant B (tablet + 1 laptop + 2 battery banks). We'll label the crate manifest accordingly and include spare chargers.
4) Freight: open to the 72-hour pickup window — Logan, can you confirm we can get the crate to the warehouse for that lead time?

Carla — if you can update the spec PDF with the 12.5ft clearance note and resend, we'll sign-off and trigger print. Also please include final crate weight estimate for customs.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
contact: +1 415-555-0198

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Preflight details for Redwood demo pod - needs on clearance and kit variants

Eve/Marissa — can confirm we can meet the 72-hour pickup window if crates are staged at our SF consolidation yard by next Friday (12/19). 

Notes: 
- Variant B manifest looks good. I'll attach the final kit_manifest.csv once I reconcile serials and chargers.
- Estimated crate weight with Variant B + spare chargers and packaging: 128 lbs / 58 kg (single crate). If EventWorks needs palletization we need 24 hours extra.
- Customs line item: list as "marketing collateral and electronics" — export paperwork team flagged that it's the fastest classification.

Carla: please confirm whether EventWorks will palletize or ship as loose crate. If palletize, we'll shift pickup to 12/20 morning.

Thanks,
Logan
Logistics Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: kit_manifest_draft.csv

Carla
